feature.issue_title: [NFR-REL-002] Implement graceful recovery from WebGL context loss

artifacts.name: LOW_LEVEL_DESIGN
artifacts.description: Full LLD for NFR-REL-002: WebGLContextGuard component, contextRecoveryStore Zustand slice, ContextLossOverlay UI, browser event contracts, 3 Mermaid sequence diagrams, exponential backoff retry, error handling, security, accessibility, and integration test design (T-BE-REL-002-01)

summary.work_completed: Low-Level Design for NFR-REL-002 (WebGL context loss graceful recovery) authored, reviewed, and merged to main via PR #47. LLD is the authoritative design document for the frontend-test and frontend-coding agents.
key_findings: WebGLContextGuard is a pure behavior R3F component that attaches webglcontextlost/webglcontextrestored DOM event listeners via useThree()
contextRecoveryStore (new Zustand slice) tracks status: normal|lost|restoring|restored and drives ContextLossOverlay visibility
Scene reconstruction reads from sceneStore (Zustand) — GPU state loss does not destroy application state
Exponential backoff retry: 3 attempts at 0ms/500ms/1000ms before hard-failure Reload Page UI
event.preventDefault() is mandatory in handleContextLost to signal browser intent to restore context

recommended_actions: Read docs/features/NFR-REL-002/LOW_LEVEL_DESIGN.md — this is the authoritative design for all test authoring

Write integration test: frontend/tests/integration/webglContextLoss.test.ts using WEBGL_lose_context extension to simulate context loss (TC-01: no crash, TC-02: bricks restored, TC-03: loading indicator shown)
Write unit tests for WebGLContextGuard: verify handleContextLost calls event.preventDefault(), pauses render loop, sets contextRecoveryStore status to 'lost'
Write unit tests for contextRecoveryStore: verify state transitions normal→lost→restoring→restored and retry counter increments
Write unit tests for ContextLossOverlay: verify renders when status='lost'|'restoring', shows Reload Page button after 3 failed retries
Map all tests to T-BE-REL-002-01 and the 3 acceptance criteria from issue #36
next_agent_context.summary: Design for NFR-REL-002 is complete and merged. The LLD specifies WebGLContextGuard (R3F behavior component), contextRecoveryStore (Zustand slice), ContextLossOverlay (React UI), and the full recovery lifecycle with exponential backoff. Frontend-test agent must write TDD test suite covering all 3 acceptance criteria before frontend-coding agent implements production code.
